candidates.sentence: Programs that are critical for low-income and working families like social security, Medicaid and Medicare, unemployment insurance, Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF), the Child Tax Credit and Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) must be protected and expanded.
Continues to oppose efforts to make cuts or create work requirements for SNAP, TANF, Medicare, Medicaid, and other social programs

Introduced and passed the Student Veteran Benefits Restoration Act, a bipartisan bill, out of the Veteran Affairs Committee to guarantee that veterans defrauded by for profit schools will have full access to their education benefits restored
Co-sponsored the SUPPORT For SNAP Act to expand nutrition assistance programs for people experiencing homelessness

Delia has been a leader in the fight to make sure everyone has access to healthcare including championing historic expansions of Medicaid and co-sponsoring laws to reduce racial disparities in our healthcare system.

Delia is committed to fully funding the Department of Veterans Affairs and eliminating the backlog in processing VA benefits so that it is easier for veterans to access the healthcare and mental health services they need.
Delia also advocates for the thousands of veterans who have been unjustly deported and is fighting to bring them home.
